settings.language.note: Service words like odometer, brake pad and change oil stay in English, because that is what shops and mechanics say. This changes the rest of the app.
records.title: Records
records.searchPlaceholder: Search service, part, shop, or notes
drafts.note: Saved, but not added to your history until you finish and confirm.
drafts.emptyBody: Every record you've started has been confirmed and saved to your vehicle history.
count.unfinished.one: {count} service record you started but have not finished
count.unfinished.other: {count} service records you started but have not finished
method.title: How do you want to add it?
method.sub: Step 2 of 6 · you will check everything before it saves, whichever you pick
method.skipNote: Entering from a vehicle page? This step is skipped.
method.receipt.title: Photo of the receipt
method.receipt.body: We read the details off it. Multi-page receipts are fine — keep them in printed order.
method.receipt.foot: Every field will show where its value came from.
method.voice.title: Voice note
method.voice.body: Say what was done. We write it down, and you can edit every word of it.
method.voice.foot: Quickest when you have no paper.
method.manual.title: Type it in
method.manual.body: Your own words. Nothing is read or guessed — what you type is what saves.
method.manual.foot: Best for an old record you already know.
receipt.title: The receipt
receipt.sub: Add every page of one visit. Photograph them, upload them, or both.
receipt.tip1: Flat surface, good lighting, no glare or shadows
receipt.tip2: All four corners of the page visible in frame
receipt.order: The order here is the order we read them in.
receipt.longer: A long receipt takes longer. Nothing is lost while this runs.
receipt.needOne: Add at least one receipt page.
receipt.uploadFail: The pages could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
receipt.readFail: The receipt could not be read. Try again.
quality.blurry: Looks blurry — hold steady and retake
quality.lighting: Too dark or too much glare — find even light
quality.small: Too small to read — move closer
quality.generic: May not read well — try another photo
quality.confirmTitle: Some pages may not read well
quality.confirmBody: The marked pages may not read well. Retake them for a better result, or read them as they are.
quality.serverStopped: Some pages may not read well, so nothing was read yet. Retake the marked pages, or read them anyway.
quality.readClearOnly: Remove marked pages and read the rest
quality.allMarked: None of these pages is likely to read well. Replace or remove them to continue.
voice.title: Say what was done
voice.original: The original stays exactly as you said it. This is what we will read.
voice.copyKept: This is the copy we keep. Editing here changes what we read.
voice.noRecorder: This browser cannot record audio. You can type what you want to say instead.
voice.noMic: Trevora could not reach the microphone. Allow access, or type what you want to say instead.
voice.needNote: Record a voice note, or type what you want to say, before going on.
manual.title: Type in the details
manual.sub: Only the date and the total are required.
manual.serviceThenLines: A service, then the lines that paid for it.
vehicle.noRecordsHere: No records for this vehicle yet
auth.needEmail: Enter an email address we can reach you at.
auth.retype: Re-type it so we know it is what you meant.
auth.mismatch: These two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a number.
auth.acceptTerms: Please accept the Terms to continue.
review.title: Check the details
review.coveredBy: Insurance or warranty covered part of this
review.coveredHelp: How much of the total someone else paid. Leave blank if you paid all of it.
review.coverageKind.goodwill: Goodwill from the shop or dealer
review.totalFirst: Enter the total cost first, then how much of it was covered.
review.nothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded with this one.
confirm.title: This is what will be saved
confirm.notEditable: Nothing here is editable. Go back if anything is wrong.
confirm.checked: I have checked these details and they match my receipt
confirm.required: Required. You can edit the record later, and the change is logged.
confirm.stillNeed: Some fields still need attention. Go back to checking to finish them.
saved.title: Saved to your records
lines.noItemised: No itemised lines for this service.
lines.inOrder: Lines stay in the order they print, so you can read down the paper.
lines.fillTotal: Fill in the total cost and this will check it against the lines.
lines.noneHaveAmount: None of the lines have an amount, so they cannot be checked against the total.
share.noOne: No one has access right now
share.sessionFromApprovalUnknown: A few hours from your approval
share.nothingElse: No other vehicle, no drafts, no edits
requests.nothingShared: Nothing is shared until you approve it
notif.title: Notifications
notif.requestsArrive: Mechanic access requests for your vehicles arrive here.
addVehicle.title: Add a vehicle
addVehicle.nicknameHelp: Optional. It is how most people recognise their own car in a list.
set.title: Account settings
set.sub: Your notifications, your details, and your password.
set.detailsHelp: Your name and email are how Trevora identifies you on every record.
set.passwordHelp: We ask for your current password first, to make sure it is you.
set.noMatch: These two do not match yet.
set.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
set.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
set.whoCanSee: These are about who can see your records.
set.youDecide: You decide before anyone can see anything.
set.noLongerSee: The mechanic can no longer see the vehicle.
set.savedEmail: Saved. Check your inbox to confirm the new email address.
set.thisDevice: On this device. Your records stay where they are.
set.deleteWarn1: A mechanic reading this history right now will lose it.
set.deleteWarn2: Any share link or mechanic access you have granted stops working immediately.
set.deleteWarn3: This removes every vehicle and service record on this account, along with their receipt images.
shell.signOutBody: Your records stay where they are. You will need to sign in again to reach them.
shell.unsavedWarn: Anything you are part-way through adding is not saved yet and will be lost.
parts.pickPart: Pick a part to see its full service history.
vehicle.trySearch: Try a shop name, a part, or the kind of service.
vehicle.deleteBody: It disappears from this vehicle's history and from everything worked out from it.
vehicle.onlyVehicleGoes: Nothing has been filed against it yet, so only the vehicle goes.
rail.fixAbove: Fix what is listed above to continue.
rail.nothingStopping: Nothing is stopping this from being saved. Anything still flagged is yours to judge.
rail.oneThing: One thing has to change before this can be saved. The rest is yours to judge.
rail.savedAsYouGo: Your changes are saved as you continue.
garage.latestAcrossAll: Latest service records across all vehicles
garage.chartHint: Add a record and twelve months of service activity chart here.
garage.startReceipt: We read the date, shop, services and cost off it. You correct anything before it saves.
garage.startVoice: Say what was done and we write it down. Quickest when you have no paper.
garage.startManual: Your own words, nothing guessed. Best for a service you already know.
ai.loading: Putting this record into plain language…
ai.fromRecord: Written from the record itself rather than by the explanation service.
ai.disclaimer: This explanation is for understanding only and does not replace professional mechanic judgment.
ai.feedback.whatWentWrong: What was off about this explanation?
dup.title: This may already be in your records
veh.wrongVehicle: This may be the wrong vehicle
veh.eitherOr: Either this receipt belongs to another vehicle, or to one you have not added yet. Scanning again throws this draft away and starts over — nothing has been saved to your history.
veh.offerLeadOne: This receipt prints a detail your {vehicle} has no record of. Add it?
veh.offerLeadMany: This receipt prints details your {vehicle} has no record of. Add them?
warrantyOffer.offerLead: This receipt prints a warranty period your {vehicle} has no record of. Add it?
warrantyOffer.conflictLead: This receipt prints a different warranty period from your {vehicle}'s. Nothing changes unless you choose the receipt's.
warrantyNotice.lead: The warranty period printed on this receipt was added to your {vehicle}.
veh.doesNotMatch: What this receipt prints does not match {vehicle}.
leave.title: Keep this as a draft?
leave.body: This receipt has already been read and a draft exists. Keeping it saves your corrections and puts it under “Not finished yet”, ready to come back to. Deleting removes the draft and its receipt pages for good.
concerns.placeholder: AC not cold. Weird sound when turning left.
concerns.hint: Written down now so it is not forgotten at the counter.
concerns.none: Nothing noted for this vehicle yet.
confirm.concernsTitle: Did this cover any of these?
confirm.concernsNote: Tick anything this visit dealt with. You can skip this.
warranty.empty.title: Warranty not set
warranty.empty.body: Add your coverage terms to see whether this vehicle is still under warranty. Useful when deciding between a local shop and the dealer.
warranty.limits.both: Until {date} or {km} km — whichever comes first
warranty.distance.over: {current} km recorded · {over} km past the {limit} km limit
warranty.gap.noStartDate: Purchase date not set, so the time limit cannot be checked.
warranty.gap.noMonths: Coverage period not set, so the time limit cannot be checked.
warranty.gap.noKmLimit: No mileage limit recorded, so the distance limit cannot be checked.
warranty.gap.noOdometer: No odometer reading recorded yet, so the distance limit cannot be checked.
warranty.source.owner: Based on information provided by the owner.
warranty.source.receipt: Read from a service receipt. Not checked with the dealer.
warranty.spend.title: Covered by insurance or a warranty
warranty.spend.body: PHP {amount} has been recorded as covered on this vehicle's service records. That is what a policy paid on individual visits, not the manufacturer warranty above.
warranty.field.startDateHint: The day you took delivery. Not the model year.
warranty.field.help: Most vehicles in the Philippines are covered for 3 years or 100,000 km, but terms vary by brand — check your warranty booklet.
warranty.dialog.title: Warranty coverage
warranty.dialog.lead: All three are optional, and each one is useful on its own — record what you have and leave the rest blank. A wrong number reads as authoritative later.
receiptLimit.over: You can read {left} more receipt pages this hour, so these {pages} won't all fit. Come back {when} to read them all, or remove some pages.
receiptLimit.overToday: You can read {left} more receipt pages today, so these {pages} won't all fit. Come back {when} to read them all, or remove some pages.
receiptLimit.reachedHour: You've read the most receipt pages allowed for this hour. Come back {when} ({in}) to read more.
receiptLimit.reachedDay: You've read the most receipt pages allowed for today. Come back {when} ({in}) to read more.
receiptLimit.reachedNoTime: You can't read more receipt pages right now. Come back a little later.
receiptLimit.burst: Too many uploads at once. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
receiptLimit.budget: Reading receipts with AI is paused on your account for today. You can still add this record by typing it in.
receiptLimit.tooBig: One receipt can have up to {max} pages. Split this one into two uploads.
receiptLimit.warning: Unusual activity: this account sent a lot of receipt uploads that were refused in a short time. Please slow down. If it keeps happening, your account may be suspended.
receiptLimit.finalWarning: Final warning: this account is still sending receipt uploads that are being refused. If it happens again, your account will be suspended.
lines.splitUnreadable: The receipt prints separate totals for parts and labour, but we couldn't read them clearly, so we couldn't check that each amount is on the right line. Check the amounts against the paper.
lines.railSplitMismatch: Amounts may be on the wrong lines — parts and labour don't match the receipt.
lines.railSplitUnreadable: Couldn't check parts and labour against the receipt.
lines.railOverTotal: Lines are {gap} over the receipt total.
lines.railShortTotal: Lines are {gap} short of the receipt total.
lines.railOverCharges: Lines are {gap} over the receipt's charges.
lines.railShortCharges: Lines are {gap} short of the receipt's charges.
lines.addAmounts: Add the amounts from the receipt to make this check work.
lines.matchesReceipt: Amounts add up to the receipt's totals
lines.wrongLines: Some amounts are on the wrong lines.
lines.wrongLinesUnpricedOne: Some amounts are on the wrong lines, and 1 line has no amount.
lines.wrongLinesUnpricedOther: Some amounts are on the wrong lines, and {count} lines have no amount.
lines.amountsDontMatch: Some amounts don't match the receipt.
lines.sourcesDisagree: The receipt's figures disagree; these are from its totals box.
lines.leaveGap: Change a figure, or leave the difference.
lines.gapUncheckedUnpricedOne: Parts and labour weren't checked either, because 1 line has no amount.
lines.gapUncheckedUnpricedOther: Parts and labour weren't checked either, because {count} lines have no amount.
lines.gapUncheckedUnreadable: Parts and labour weren't checked either, because we couldn't read them on the receipt.
rail.readyButCheck: Nothing is stopping this from being saved, but the amounts don't match the receipt yet. Check them before you continue.
rail.readyButUnchecked: Nothing is stopping this from being saved, but we couldn't fully check the amounts against the receipt. Check them before you continue.
rail.manyThings: {count} things have to change before this can be saved. The rest is yours to judge.
